# 1. Configuration & Setup

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 1.1 GLOBAL DIRECTORY & PIPELINE CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

# Experiment identifier. Matches upstream Python pre-processing output nomenclature.
experiment_id <- "E1"

# Parent directory containing all component-specific subdirectories.
root_dir <- "C:/Code/UG_ERP_Project/results/EEG" 

# Temporal step size (in milliseconds) for high-density topographic grids.
time_course_step_ms <- 40 

# ==============================================================================
# 1.2 DEPENDENCY MANAGEMENT
# ==============================================================================
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, stringr, fs, gridExtra, scales, here, cowplot, purrr)

# eegUtils is strictly required for topographic interpolation and spatial mapping.
if (!require("eegUtils")) {
  stop("Critical Package Missing: 'eegUtils'. Install via devtools::install_github('craddm/eegUtils')")
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1.2.1 PUBLICATION-GRADE THEME & OUTPUT CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================
# Centralizes all dimensions, font sizes, and output formats. Values follow
# common conventions for cognitive psychophysiology journals (Psychophysiology,
# NeuroImage, Cognition). Adjust here once; all downstream plot calls inherit.
#
# Figure dimensions: single-column (89 mm = 3.5 in) for one-up topographies;
# the height is slightly larger than width to accommodate title + subtitle +
# caption blocks below the topographic disc.
#
# Font sizes follow the "≥ 7 pt at final print size" rule (most journals).
# We use 8 pt for primary labels, 7 pt for secondary metadata, 9 pt for the
# main title (which carries the most semantic weight).
#
# Vector output (PDF) is essential for publication-grade rendering; raster
# (PNG, 600 DPI) is retained for quick inspection and for environments where
# vector embedding fails (e.g., older Word workflows).
THEME_CONFIG <- list(
  # Figure dimensions (inches; 1 in = 25.4 mm).
  # v2.3.1: widened from 3.5 in to 4.5 in to give the topographic disc more
  # breathing room. Kept in v2.3.2 because the wider layout is a clean win
  # independent of the ROI-marker debacle.
  fig_width_single  = 4.5,    # widened for clean disc + colorbar layout
  fig_height_single = 4.0,    # accommodates title/subtitle/caption stack
  fig_width_grid    = 7.2,    # 183 mm — two-column figure (for time grids)
  
  # Font sizes (pt at final size).
  font_family      = "sans",
  size_title       = 9,
  size_subtitle    = 8,
  size_caption     = 7,
  size_legend_ttl  = 8,
  size_legend_txt  = 7,
  size_grid_label  = 8,
  size_grid_panel  = 7,
  
  # Output formats.
  dpi              = 600,
  emit_pdf         = FALSE,
  emit_png         = TRUE,
  
  # Caption wrapping width for the 4.5 in figure layout.
  caption_wrap_width = 70,
  
  # eegUtils topoplot() scaling factor. Default = 1.0; smaller values
  # proportionally reduce ALL visual elements (electrode dots, head shape,
  # highlight markers, contour lines). 0.9 = "10% smaller, more refined look"
  # without distorting the visual hierarchy.
  topoplot_scaling = 0.9,
  
  # Global plot margin (mm).
  plot_margin_mm   = c(3, 3, 3, 3)
)

# ==============================================================================
# 1.3 COMPONENT & SPATIOTEMPORAL DEFINITIONS
# ==============================================================================
# Components (windows + ROIs) are read from the single source of truth shared
# with the pipeline, stats, and waveform scripts:
#   config/erp_components.csv  (t_min/t_max/test_tmin/test_tmax in SECONDS;
#   roi pipe-delimited). For each component this builds two specs: the primary
# window (<Comp>) and a wider exploratory sweep (test<Comp>) for the time-course
# grids. Topography windows are expressed here in milliseconds (win_ms).
comp_csv <- here::here("config", "erp_components.csv")
if (!file.exists(comp_csv)) {
  stop(sprintf("Component config not found: %s", comp_csv))
}
comp_def <- readr::read_csv(comp_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
comp_def <- comp_def[comp_def$experiment == experiment_id, ]

component_specs <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(comp_def))) {
  cn  <- comp_def$comp_name[i]
  roi <- strsplit(comp_def$roi[i], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  component_specs[[cn]] <- list(
    win_ms      = as.integer(round(c(comp_def$t_min[i], comp_def$t_max[i]) * 1000)),
    roi         = roi,
    source_comp = cn
  )
  component_specs[[paste0("test", cn)]] <- list(
    win_ms      = as.integer(round(c(comp_def$test_tmin[i], comp_def$test_tmax[i]) * 1000)),
    roi         = roi,
    source_comp = cn
  )
}

# Formal nomenclature aligned with upstream Python pipeline ('enj' mapped to Reward).
emotion_list <- c("aff", "dis", "dom", "enj")
emotion_labels <- c(neu = "Neutral", aff = "Affiliative", dis = "Disgust", dom = "Dominance", enj = "Reward")
offer_types  <- c("fair", "unfair")

cat(sprintf("Pipeline Initialized.\nTarget Experiment: %s\nData Root: %s\n", experiment_id, root_dir))
```

# 2. Methodological Helper Functions

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# LMM Provenance Reader
# ==============================================================================
# Reads <session>/Regression_Results/<COMP>_lmm_provenance.txt (written by
# Visualization_EEG_StiLocked.py v2.1) and returns a compact metadata block
# suitable for figure captions. Provides full chain-of-custody from upstream
# LMM (Sta_EEG_OfferPhase_RefAlday.Rmd) through viz reconstruction (Python)
# down to the topographic figure (this script).
#
# Returns NULL on any failure (file absent, parse error). Callers should
# fall back to a minimal caption when NULL is returned.
read_lmm_provenance <- function(provenance_file) {
  if (!file.exists(provenance_file)) return(NULL)
  txt <- tryCatch(readLines(provenance_file, warn = FALSE),
                  error = function(e) return(NULL))
  if (is.null(txt)) return(NULL)
  
  extract <- function(pattern) {
    line <- grep(pattern, txt, value = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.na(line)) return(NA_character_)
    sub(paste0("^.*?", pattern, "\\s*"), "", line)
  }
  
  list(
    lmm_generated   = extract("LMM generated:"),
    lmm_n           = extract("LMM Observations:"),
    lmm_singular    = extract("LMM Singular fit:"),
    has_emo_BL      = extract("has_emo_BL\\s*:"),
    has_offer_BL    = extract("has_offer_BL\\s*:"),
    has_emo_offer   = extract("has_emo_offer\\s*:"),
    formula_lmm     = extract("Final formula \\(LMM\\):") 
                      %||% extract("Final formula:")
  )
}
# Helper for null-safe extraction.
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || is.na(a) || a == "") b else a

# Construct a publication-grade caption from provenance + spec metadata.
#
# v2.3 caption philosophy: minimum information necessary for a reader to
# identify the figure without consulting the manuscript. Detailed provenance
# (LMM run timestamp, retained interactions, design matrix) belongs in the
# accompanying lmm_provenance.txt and Methods section, NOT in the caption.
#
# Caption structure (2 lines):
#   Line 1: "{COMP} ({window}). {method_label}."
#   Line 2: "ROI: {channels}. N = {n_trials} trials, {n_subjects} subjects."
#
# Both lines wrap at THEME_CONFIG$caption_wrap_width to fit the 89 mm figure.
# The component label is derived from comp_name by the caller (passed in).
build_publication_caption <- function(spec, method_label, provenance, 
                                      experiment_id, comp_label,
                                      n_subjects = 30) {
  win_str <- sprintf("%d-%d ms", spec$win_ms[1], spec$win_ms[2])
  roi_str <- paste(spec$roi, collapse = ", ")
  ww <- THEME_CONFIG$caption_wrap_width
  
  # Line 1: component + window + method.
  line1 <- str_wrap(sprintf("%s (%s). %s.", comp_label, win_str, method_label),
                    width = ww)
  
  # Line 2: ROI + sample.
  if (!is.null(provenance) && !is.na(provenance$lmm_n)) {
    line2 <- str_wrap(sprintf("ROI: %s. N = %s trials, %d subjects.",
                              roi_str, provenance$lmm_n, n_subjects),
                      width = ww)
  } else {
    line2 <- str_wrap(sprintf("ROI: %s.", roi_str), width = ww)
  }
  
  paste(c(line1, line2), collapse = "\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dynamic Scale Limit Computation (Adaptive Precision Method)
# Evaluates pooled magnitude to determine optimal rounding step, maximizing 
# visual contrast for weak signals while maintaining zero-center symmetry.
# ==============================================================================
compute_limits <- function(values, symmetric = TRUE, prob_thresh = 0.99) {
  if (all(is.na(values))) return(c(-0.1, 0.1))
  
  if (symmetric) {
    max_val <- quantile(abs(values), probs = prob_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.infinite(max_val) || max_val == 0) return(c(-0.1, 0.1))
    
    # Adaptive step resolution based on overall signal magnitude
    if (max_val <= 0.5) {
      step <- 0.05
    } else if (max_val <= 1.0) {
      step <- 0.1
    } else if (max_val <= 2.5) {
      step <- 0.25
    } else {
      step <- 0.5
    }
    
    max_val <- ceiling(max_val / step) * step
    if (max_val == 0) max_val <- step 
    
    return(c(-max_val, max_val))
  } else {
    return(quantile(values, probs = c(1 - prob_thresh, prob_thresh), na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Unified Publication-Ready Topographic Plotting Engine (v2.1 academic-grade)
# 
# Renders a single topographic disc with:
#   - Title (component + analytical context), subtitle (condition labels),
#     and multi-line caption (sample/method/window/ROI/LMM provenance).
#   - White-fill / black-outline ROI markers (visible against any palette).
#   - Symmetric RdBu palette with publication-standard colorbar.
#   - Both PNG (raster, 600 DPI for inspection) and PDF (vector, for
#     publication submission) emitted side-by-side, controlled by THEME_CONFIG.
#
# All sizing, font, and output toggles flow from THEME_CONFIG (see § 1.2.1)
# so cosmetic adjustments require editing only one block at the top.
# ==============================================================================
plot_topo_unified <- function(dat_long, chan_locs, roi, 
                              main_title, sub_title, caption_text, 
                              filename, limits, show_contour = TRUE) {
  
  if(!"electrode" %in% names(dat_long)) {
    warning("Spatial mapping failure: 'electrode' identifier absent.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  safe_title <- str_wrap(main_title, width = 50)
  safe_sub   <- str_wrap(sub_title, width = 50)
  
  # v2.3.2 ROI marker strategy: use eegUtils built-in `highlights = roi`.
  #
  # History (so future maintainers don't repeat the mistake):
  #   v2.2  — Tried to overlay custom geom_point with chanlocs$x/y, assuming
  #           those coords matched topoplot's internal coord system. Resulting
  #           markers appeared visually offset; reverted.
  #   v2.3.1 — Tried `topoplot(points = FALSE, highlights = NULL)` then
  #            overlaid two geom_point layers (small for all electrodes, big
  #            for ROI). Failed because the eegUtils argument is `chan_marker`
  #            (not `points`), so topoplot's default markers were never
  #            actually disabled — the overlays compounded with the defaults
  #            into a visually chaotic mix of dot sizes.
  #   v2.3.2 (current) — Stop trying to customize. Use eegUtils built-in
  #            highlight (which is white-filled and positionally accurate)
  #            and accept the visual trade-off. ROI is also explicitly named
  #            in the caption ("ROI: P7, P8, PO7, PO8") for unambiguity.
  #
  # If a future iteration truly needs size-based ROI emphasis, the path is to
  # rewrite the function using geom_topo()-based assembly (full ggplot2 layer
  # control), not topoplot()'s wrapper. That requires more debugging budget
  # than has been available here.
  p <- topoplot(
    dat_long, chan_locs = chan_locs, interp_limit = "head",
    contour = show_contour, points = TRUE, highlights = roi,
    palette = "RdBu", limits = limits,
    scaling = THEME_CONFIG$topoplot_scaling
  )
  
  # Title / subtitle / caption / theme — all sizing from THEME_CONFIG.
  p <- p +
    labs(title = safe_title, subtitle = safe_sub, caption = caption_text) +
    theme(
      text          = element_text(family = THEME_CONFIG$font_family),
      plot.title    = element_text(size = THEME_CONFIG$size_title,
                                    face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(t = 4, b = 2)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = THEME_CONFIG$size_subtitle,
                                    hjust = 0.5, color = "grey20",
                                    margin = margin(b = 6)),
      plot.caption  = element_text(size = THEME_CONFIG$size_caption,
                                    hjust = 0, color = "grey30",
                                    lineheight = 1.1,
                                    margin = margin(t = 6)),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.title     = element_text(size = THEME_CONFIG$size_legend_ttl,
                                       face = "bold"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = THEME_CONFIG$size_legend_txt),
      plot.margin      = margin(THEME_CONFIG$plot_margin_mm[1],
                                THEME_CONFIG$plot_margin_mm[2],
                                THEME_CONFIG$plot_margin_mm[3],
                                THEME_CONFIG$plot_margin_mm[4],
                                unit = "mm"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      title          = "Amplitude\n(\u00b5V)",
      barheight      = unit(3.0, "cm"),
      barwidth       = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      ticks.linewidth = 0.6,
      title.position = "top"
    ))
  
  base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename)
  
  if (THEME_CONFIG$emit_pdf) {
    ggsave(paste0(base, ".pdf"), plot = p, device = cairo_pdf,
           width  = THEME_CONFIG$fig_width_single,
           height = THEME_CONFIG$fig_height_single,
           bg = "white")
  }
  if (THEME_CONFIG$emit_png) {
    ggsave(paste0(base, ".png"), plot = p, device = "png",
           width  = THEME_CONFIG$fig_width_single,
           height = THEME_CONFIG$fig_height_single,
           dpi = THEME_CONFIG$dpi, bg = "white")
  }
  return(p)
}

```

# 3. Component Processing & Visualization Engine

```{r}
for (comp_name in names(component_specs)) {
  
  spec <- component_specs[[comp_name]]
  time_win_str <- paste0(spec$win_ms[1], " - ", spec$win_ms[2], " ms")
  
  target_source <- ifelse(!is.null(spec$source_comp), spec$source_comp, comp_name)
  target_folder_name <- paste0("Results_", target_source, "_", experiment_id)
  comp_results_dir   <- file.path(root_dir, target_folder_name)
  
  cat(paste0("\n", str_dup("#", 75), "\n"))
  cat(sprintf("ANALYSIS TARGET: %s | PHYSICAL SOURCE: %s\n", comp_name, target_folder_name))
  cat(paste0(str_dup("#", 75), "\n"))
  
  if (!dir_exists(comp_results_dir)) {
    cat(sprintf("Directory unresolved: %s. Skipping.\n", comp_results_dir))
    next
  }
  
  sessions <- dir_ls(comp_results_dir, glob = "*Session_*", type = "directory")
  if (length(sessions) == 0) {
    cat("Session index empty. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  current_session <- sort(sessions, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
  
  chan_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "channel_locations.csv")
  if (!file.exists(chan_file)) chan_file <- file.path(current_session, "Standard_Baseline", "channel_locations.csv")
  if (!file.exists(chan_file)) {
    cat("Spatial montage missing. Skipping.\n")
    next
  }
  
  chanlocs <- read_csv(chan_file, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE) %>% rename(electrode = channel)
  methods_to_run <- c("Regression")  #"Regression","Standard"
  
  # ============================================================================
  # v2.3: Cross-method shared color scale (Regression-led)
  # ============================================================================
  # Both Regression and Standard topographies use the SAME 7-tier color scale,
  # determined by Regression first. Rationale:
  #   - Regression (Alday 2019 baseline-as-covariate) is the primary analysis
  #     producing the LMM-aligned marginal means; Standard is a sensitivity
  #     check / reference visualization.
  #   - Visual comparability across methods requires a shared scale.
  #   - Regression-led (rather than Standard-led, or pooled max) faithfully
  #     reflects the primary analysis's signal range. Standard topographies
  #     may saturate (clip to scale extremes) on this scale, but that is the
  #     correct visual signature of "Standard signals are larger than the
  #     baseline-corrected Regression marginal means" — a real methodological
  #     fact, not an artifact.
  #
  # Container initialized as NULL; populated when method=="Regression" runs;
  # consumed when method=="Standard" runs. If Regression is skipped (e.g. for
  # exploratory test* windows where target_source != comp_name in a
  # way that bypasses Regression), Standard falls back to its own limits.
  shared_lims <- list(
    raw  = NULL, main = NULL,
    diff_emo_main = NULL, diff_offer_main = NULL,
    diff_cond_emo = NULL, diff_cond_offer = NULL
  )
  
  for (method in methods_to_run) {
    if (method == "Regression" && comp_name != target_source) {
      cat(sprintf("\n  >>> Analytical Method: %s [GUARD INTERCEPT] Skipped.\n", method))
      next
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("\n  >>> Analytical Method: %s\n", method))
    topo_data <- NULL; title_prefix <- ""; caption_method <- ""
    
    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.1 DATA INGESTION 
    # ==========================================================================
    if (method == "Regression") {
      f <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results", "topomap_data_for_R", paste0(target_source, "_topomap_data.csv"))
      if (file.exists(f)) {
        topo_data <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE)
        title_prefix <- "Marginal Means (Regression)"
        # v2.1: caption updated to match upstream baseline handling.
        # Pre-v2.1 used Z-scored baseline; v2.1+ uses mean-centered baseline
        # following Alday (2019) recommendations. Keeps baseline in microvolts
        # so that beta_baseline is interpretable as fraction of pre-stimulus
        # drift propagated forward. See Sta_EEG_OfferPhase_RefAlday.Rmd v2.1
        # and Visualization_EEG_StiLocked.py for upstream consistency.
        caption_method <- "Marginal means from linear modeling (Alday 2019; baseline as mean-centered covariate)"
      } else { cat("    File absent. Skipping.\n"); next }
      
    } else if (method == "Standard") {
      f <- file.path(current_session, "Standard_Baseline", paste0(target_source, "_ave_labelled.csv"))
      if (file.exists(f)) {
        raw_df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE, lazy = FALSE)
        valid_chans <- intersect(names(raw_df), chanlocs$electrode)
        
        df_agg <- raw_df %>%
          pivot_longer(all_of(valid_chans), names_to = "channel", values_to = "uV") %>%
          mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
          filter(time_ms >= spec$win_ms[1] & time_ms <= spec$win_ms[2]) %>%
          group_by(channel, emotion, offer_type) %>%
          summarise(mean_amp = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
        
        topo_data <- df_agg %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = c(emotion, offer_type), values_from = mean_amp, names_sep = "_") %>%
          rename_with(~paste0("raw_", .), -channel)
          
        title_prefix <- "Evoked Amplitude (Standard)"
        caption_method <- "Traditional Pre-stimulus Subtraction (-200 to 0 ms)"
      } else { cat("    File absent. Skipping.\n"); next }
    }
    
    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.2 FACTORIAL DIFFERENCE COMPUTATION
    # ==========================================================================
    if (!is.null(topo_data)) {
      for(o in offer_types) {
        neu_col <- paste0("raw_neu_", o)
        for(e in emotion_list) {
          tgt <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", o)
          if(neu_col %in% names(topo_data) & tgt %in% names(topo_data)) 
            topo_data[[paste0("conditional_diff_", e, "_vs_neu_", o)]] <- topo_data[[tgt]] - topo_data[[neu_col]]
        }
        cols <- paste0("raw_", c("neu", emotion_list), "_", o)
        valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
        if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("offer_main_", o)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
      }
      
      for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        cols <- paste0("raw_", e, "_", offer_types)
        valid <- cols[cols %in% names(topo_data)]
        if(length(valid)>0) topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] <- rowMeans(topo_data[, valid], na.rm=TRUE)
        if(e != "neu" && paste0("emotion_main_", e) %in% names(topo_data) && "emotion_main_neu" %in% names(topo_data)) {
           topo_data[[paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")]] <- topo_data[[paste0("emotion_main_", e)]] - topo_data[["emotion_main_neu"]]
        }
      }
      
      if("offer_main_unfair" %in% names(topo_data) && "offer_main_fair" %in% names(topo_data)) {
        topo_data[["offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair"]] <- topo_data[["offer_main_unfair"]] - topo_data[["offer_main_fair"]]
      }

      for(e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        unfair_col <- paste0("raw_", e, "_unfair")
        fair_col   <- paste0("raw_", e, "_fair")
        if(unfair_col %in% names(topo_data) && fair_col %in% names(topo_data)) {
          topo_data[[paste0("offer_diff_conditional_", e, "_unfair_vs_fair")]] <- topo_data[[unfair_col]] - topo_data[[fair_col]]
        }
      }
    }

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.3 POOLED DYNAMIC SCALING & DIRECTORY PROVISIONING
    # ==========================================================================
    subfolder <- ifelse(method == "Regression", "Regression_Results", "Standard_Baseline")
    out_base <- file.path(current_session, subfolder, paste0("topoplots_R_", comp_name))
    
    # File-naming factory: each output PNG/PDF carries EXP and method tags in
    # its basename so a single figure file is self-identifying when filed in
    # supplementary materials (e.g., "FRN_E2_reg_diff_unfair_vs_fair.pdf"
    # rather than the prior "FRN_diff_unfair_vs_fair.png" which lost context
    # once moved out of its parent directory).
    method_tag <- if (method == "Regression") "reg" else "std"
    fname <- function(subdir, basename_core, ext = "png") {
      file.path(out_base, subdir, paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_",
                                         method_tag, "_", basename_core, ".", ext))
    }
    
    dir_map_static <- c("raw", "diff", "emotion_main", "emotion_diff", "offer_main", "offer_diff", "offer_diff_conditional")
    walk(file.path(out_base, dir_map_static), dir_create)
    
    if (method == "Standard" && exists("raw_df")) {
      dir_map_tc <- c("raw_offer", "raw_emotion", "raw_cond", "diff_offer", "diff_emotion", "diff_cond")
      walk(file.path(out_base, "time_course_grids", dir_map_tc), dir_create)
    }
    
    topo_long <- topo_data %>% rename(electrode = channel)
    
    raw_cols  <- grep("^raw_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    main_cols <- grep("_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    
    emo_main_diff_cols   <- grep("emotion_diff_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    offer_main_diff_cols <- grep("offer_diff_main_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    cond_emo_diff_cols   <- grep("conditional_diff_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)
    cond_offer_diff_cols <- grep("offer_diff_conditional_", names(topo_long), value = TRUE)

    raw_vals  <- if(length(raw_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, raw_cols]) else 0
    main_vals <- if(length(main_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, main_cols]) else 0
    
    emo_main_diff_vals   <- if(length(emo_main_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, emo_main_diff_cols]) else 0
    offer_main_diff_vals <- if(length(offer_main_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, offer_main_diff_cols]) else 0
    cond_emo_diff_vals   <- if(length(cond_emo_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, cond_emo_diff_cols]) else 0
    cond_offer_diff_vals <- if(length(cond_offer_diff_cols) > 0) unlist(topo_long[, cond_offer_diff_cols]) else 0
    
    if (method == "Standard" && exists("raw_df")) {
        valid_chans_tc <- intersect(names(raw_df), chanlocs$electrode)
        df_tc_scan <- raw_df %>%
          mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
          filter(time_ms >= spec$win_ms[1] & time_ms <= spec$win_ms[2]) %>%
          pivot_longer(all_of(valid_chans_tc), names_to = "channel", values_to = "uV") %>%
          group_by(time, channel, emotion, offer_type) %>%
          summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
          
        raw_vals <- c(raw_vals, df_tc_scan$uV)
    }

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.3.x SHARED COLOR-SCALE PROVISIONING (v2.3)
    # ==========================================================================
    # Regression branch: compute limits from this method's data and store into
    #   shared_lims for the subsequent Standard branch to consume.
    # Standard branch: prefer the limits stored by Regression (cross-method
    #   visual comparability); fall back to independent computation only if
    #   Regression was skipped or did not populate the container.
    if (method == "Regression") {
      lims_raw             <- compute_limits(raw_vals)
      lims_main            <- compute_limits(main_vals)
      lims_diff_emo_main   <- compute_limits(emo_main_diff_vals)
      lims_diff_offer_main <- compute_limits(offer_main_diff_vals)
      lims_diff_cond_emo   <- compute_limits(cond_emo_diff_vals)
      lims_diff_cond_offer <- compute_limits(cond_offer_diff_vals)
      
      # Persist for Standard branch.
      shared_lims$raw             <- lims_raw
      shared_lims$main            <- lims_main
      shared_lims$diff_emo_main   <- lims_diff_emo_main
      shared_lims$diff_offer_main <- lims_diff_offer_main
      shared_lims$diff_cond_emo   <- lims_diff_cond_emo
      shared_lims$diff_cond_offer <- lims_diff_cond_offer
      
      cat(sprintf("       -> Limits computed from Regression (will be reused by Standard):\n"))
    } else {
      # Standard branch — try to inherit Regression's scale.
      if (!is.null(shared_lims$raw)) {
        lims_raw             <- shared_lims$raw
        lims_main            <- shared_lims$main
        lims_diff_emo_main   <- shared_lims$diff_emo_main
        lims_diff_offer_main <- shared_lims$diff_offer_main
        lims_diff_cond_emo   <- shared_lims$diff_cond_emo
        lims_diff_cond_offer <- shared_lims$diff_cond_offer
        cat(sprintf("       -> Limits INHERITED from Regression (cross-method shared scale):\n"))
      } else {
        # Fallback: Regression was unavailable for this comp_name, so Standard
        # computes its own. This path is taken e.g. for exploratory windows
        # where Regression is skipped but we still want Standard topographies.
        lims_raw             <- compute_limits(raw_vals)
        lims_main            <- compute_limits(main_vals)
        lims_diff_emo_main   <- compute_limits(emo_main_diff_vals)
        lims_diff_offer_main <- compute_limits(offer_main_diff_vals)
        lims_diff_cond_emo   <- compute_limits(cond_emo_diff_vals)
        lims_diff_cond_offer <- compute_limits(cond_offer_diff_vals)
        cat(sprintf("       -> Limits computed independently (Regression unavailable):\n"))
      }
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("       -> Raw bounds: [%.2f, %.2f] uV\n", lims_raw[1], lims_raw[2]))
    cat(sprintf("       -> Diff bounds (Emo Main): [%.2f, %.2f] uV\n", lims_diff_emo_main[1], lims_diff_emo_main[2]))
    cat(sprintf("       -> Diff bounds (Offer Main): [%.2f, %.2f] uV\n", lims_diff_offer_main[1], lims_diff_offer_main[2]))

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.3.1 LMM provenance — read from upstream viz output for caption metadata.
    # ==========================================================================
    # Visualization_EEG_StiLocked.py v2.1 writes <COMP>_lmm_provenance.txt
    # alongside the topomap CSV. We attempt to read it (Regression mode only;
    # Standard does not require this since it has no LMM correspondence).
    provenance <- NULL
    if (method == "Regression") {
      prov_file <- file.path(current_session, "Regression_Results",
                             paste0(target_source, "_lmm_provenance.txt"))
      provenance <- read_lmm_provenance(prov_file)
      if (is.null(provenance)) {
        cat(sprintf("       -> LMM provenance NOT found (%s); caption will omit LMM info.\n",
                    basename(prov_file)))
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("       -> LMM provenance loaded: N=%s, generated=%s\n",
                    provenance$lmm_n %||% "?",
                    provenance$lmm_generated %||% "?"))
      }
    }
    
    # Publication-grade caption with full chain-of-custody metadata.
    global_caption <- build_publication_caption(
      spec = spec, method_label = caption_method,
      provenance = provenance, experiment_id = experiment_id,
      comp_label = comp_name
    )

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.4 STATIC TOPOGRAPHIC RENDERINGS
    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.4.1 Raw Topographies
    for (ofr in offer_types) {
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        col <- paste0("raw_", emo, "_", ofr)
        if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
          plot_topo_unified(
            dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
            main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix), 
            sub_title = paste("Offer:", str_to_title(ofr), "| Emotion:", emotion_labels[emo]),
            caption_text = global_caption,
            filename = fname("raw", paste0(ofr, "_", emo)),
            limits = lims_raw, show_contour = TRUE
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # 3.4.2 Conditional Differences (Emotion - Neutral within Offer)
    for (ofr in offer_types) {
      for (emo in emotion_list) {
        col <- paste0("conditional_diff_", emo, "_vs_neu_", ofr)
        if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
          plot_topo_unified(
            dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
            main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Contrast"), 
            sub_title = paste("Offer:", str_to_title(ofr), "| Diff:", emotion_labels[emo], "minus Neutral"),
            caption_text = global_caption,
            filename = fname("diff", paste0(ofr, "_", emo, "_vs_neu")),
            limits = lims_diff_cond_emo, show_contour = FALSE 
          )
        }
      }
    }
    
    # 3.4.3 Offer Main Effect Topographies 
    for (ofr in offer_types) {
      col <- paste0("offer_main_", ofr)
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Main Effect"), 
          sub_title = paste("Offer Context:", str_to_title(ofr)),
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = fname("offer_main", paste0("main_offer_", ofr)), 
          limits = lims_main, show_contour = TRUE 
        )
      }
    }

    # 3.4.4 Offer Main Difference (Unfair - Fair)
    if ("offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair" %in% names(topo_long)) {
       plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = offer_diff_main_unfair_vs_fair), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Main Effect"), 
          sub_title = "Unfair minus Fair Offers", 
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = fname("offer_diff", "diff_unfair_vs_fair"),
          limits = lims_diff_offer_main, show_contour = FALSE 
       )
    }

    # 3.4.5 Emotion Main Effects
    for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
      col <- paste0("emotion_main_", e)
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Main Effect"), 
          sub_title = paste("Emotion Context:", emotion_labels[e]),
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = fname("emotion_main", paste0("main_emotion_", e)), 
          limits = lims_main, show_contour = TRUE 
        )
      }
    }

    # 3.4.6 Emotion Main Differences (Emotion - Neutral)
    for (e in emotion_list) {
      col <- paste0("emotion_diff_main_", e, "_vs_neu")
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Contrast"), 
          sub_title = paste("Main Effect:", emotion_labels[e], "minus Neutral"), 
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = fname("emotion_diff", paste0("main_diff_", e, "_vs_neu")),
          limits = lims_diff_emo_main, show_contour = FALSE 
        )
      }
    }
    
    # 3.4.7 Offer Conditional Differences (Unfair - Fair within Emotion)
    for (e in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
      col <- paste0("offer_diff_conditional_", e, "_unfair_vs_fair")
      if (col %in% names(topo_long)) {
         plot_topo_unified(
          dat_long = select(topo_long, electrode, amplitude = all_of(col)), chan_locs = chanlocs, roi = spec$roi,
          main_title = paste(comp_name, title_prefix, "- Contrast"), 
          sub_title = paste("Unfair minus Fair | Context:", emotion_labels[e]), 
          caption_text = global_caption,
          filename = fname("offer_diff_conditional", paste0("diff_unfair_vs_fair_in_", e)),
          limits = lims_diff_cond_offer, show_contour = FALSE 
        )
      }
    }

    # ==========================================================================
    # 3.5 SPATIOTEMPORAL MATRIX GENERATION (TIME COURSE GRIDS)
    # ==========================================================================
    if (method == "Standard" && exists("raw_df")) {
      
      tc_out_dir <- file.path(out_base, "time_course_grids")
      t_step <- time_course_step_ms
      
      tmins <- seq(spec$win_ms[1], spec$win_ms[2] - 1, by = t_step)
      
      build_tc_row <- function(df_subset, row_label, limits, roi, palette="RdBu") {
        # v2.3.2: same ROI strategy as plot_topo_unified — eegUtils built-in
        # highlight, no custom geom_point overlays. See plot_topo_unified
        # comment block above for the iteration history.
        plots <- purrr::map(tmins, function(tmin) {
          tmax <- min(tmin + t_step, spec$win_ms[2])
          
          dat <- df_subset %>%
             mutate(time_ms = round(time * 1000)) %>%
             filter(time_ms >= tmin & time_ms < tmax) %>%
             group_by(channel) %>%
             summarise(amplitude = mean(amplitude, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
             filter(!is.na(amplitude)) %>%
             rename(electrode = channel)

          if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
             return(ggplot() + theme_void() + 
                    ggtitle(paste0(tmin, "-", tmax, " ms")) +
                    theme(plot.title = element_text(
                      size = THEME_CONFIG$size_grid_panel, family = THEME_CONFIG$font_family,
                      hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b=4))))
          }

          p_temp <- topoplot(dat, chan_locs = chanlocs, interp_limit = "head", 
                             contour = FALSE, limits = limits, palette = palette,
                             highlights = roi,
                             scaling = THEME_CONFIG$topoplot_scaling) 
          
          p_temp + 
            ggtitle(paste0(tmin, "-", tmax, " ms")) +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(
                    size = THEME_CONFIG$size_grid_panel, family = THEME_CONFIG$font_family,
                    hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b=4)), 
                  legend.position = "none",
                  plot.margin = margin(4, 3, 4, 3, unit = "mm")) 
        })
        
        label_gg <- cowplot::ggdraw() + 
                    cowplot::draw_label(row_label, fontface = "bold",
                                        size = THEME_CONFIG$size_grid_label,
                                        fontfamily = THEME_CONFIG$font_family,
                                        angle = 90)
        
        row_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots, nrow = 1)
        cowplot::plot_grid(label_gg, row_grid, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.12, length(tmins)))
      }

      save_mega_tc <- function(row_plots, main_title, limits, file_name, time_window, palette="RdBu") {
        dummy_df <- data.frame(electrode = chanlocs$electrode[1:2], amplitude = limits)
        bar_h <- min(length(row_plots) * 1.5, 6) 
        
        dummy_p <- topoplot(dummy_df, chan_locs = chanlocs, limits = limits, palette = palette,
                            scaling = THEME_CONFIG$topoplot_scaling) +
           guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Amplitude\n(\u00b5V)", title.position = "top", 
                                        barheight = unit(bar_h, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.4, "cm"))) +
           theme(legend.position = "right", 
                 legend.title = element_text(
                   size = THEME_CONFIG$size_legend_ttl, face = "bold",
                   family = THEME_CONFIG$font_family, margin = margin(b = 6)),
                 legend.text = element_text(
                   size = THEME_CONFIG$size_legend_txt, family = THEME_CONFIG$font_family),
                 legend.margin = margin(0, 6, 0, 6)) 
        shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(dummy_p)

        mega_stack <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = row_plots, ncol = 1)
        stack_w_leg <- cowplot::plot_grid(mega_stack, shared_legend, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(length(tmins), 0.8))

        safe_main_title <- stringr::str_wrap(paste0(main_title, " | Window: ", time_window), width = 75)
        title_gg <- cowplot::ggdraw() + 
                    cowplot::draw_label(safe_main_title, fontface = "bold",
                                        size = THEME_CONFIG$size_title + 2,
                                        fontfamily = THEME_CONFIG$font_family,
                                        lineheight = 1.2) +
                    theme(plot.margin = margin(8, 4, 5, 4))
                    
        final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(title_gg, stack_w_leg, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.6, length(row_plots) * 2.0))

        # Width scales with number of time bins; height with number of rows.
        # Tighter dimensions than v2.0 (was 2.8 cm/panel; now ~2.0) to keep
        # multi-row grids printable as supplementary figures.
        dynamic_width <- max(8, 2.0 + (length(tmins) * 1.6) + 1.5)
        dynamic_height <- 1.5 + (length(row_plots) * 2.0)

        # Dual-format output for time-course grids.
        base <- file.path(tc_out_dir, tools::file_path_sans_ext(file_name))
        
        if (THEME_CONFIG$emit_pdf) {
          ggsave(paste0(base, ".pdf"), final_plot,
                 device = cairo_pdf,
                 width = dynamic_width, height = dynamic_height,
                 bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
        }
        if (THEME_CONFIG$emit_png) {
          ggsave(paste0(base, ".png"), final_plot,
                 device = "png",
                 width = dynamic_width, height = dynamic_height,
                 dpi = THEME_CONFIG$dpi, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
        }
      }

      valid_chans_tc <- intersect(names(raw_df), chanlocs$electrode)
      df_tc_base <- raw_df %>%
        pivot_longer(all_of(valid_chans_tc), names_to = "channel", values_to = "uV") %>%
        group_by(time, channel, emotion, offer_type) %>%
        summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")

      row_plots <- list()
      for (ofr in offer_types) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>% filter(offer_type == ofr) %>%
                    group_by(time, channel) %>% summarise(amplitude = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste("Offer:", str_to_title(ofr)), lims_raw, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Evolution: Main Effects of Offer"), 
                   lims_raw,
                   file.path("raw_offer",
                             paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_std_TC_Raw_Offer")),
                   time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>% filter(emotion == emo) %>%
                    group_by(time, channel) %>% summarise(amplitude = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste("Emotion:", emotion_labels[emo]), lims_raw, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Evolution: Main Effects of Emotion"), 
                   lims_raw,
                   file.path("raw_emotion",
                             paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_std_TC_Raw_Emotion")),
                   time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        for (ofr in offer_types) {
          df_slice <- df_tc_base %>% filter(offer_type == ofr, emotion == emo) %>% rename(amplitude = uV)
          row_label <- paste0(emotion_labels[emo], "\n(", str_to_title(ofr), ")")
          row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, row_label, lims_raw, spec$roi)
        }
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Evolution: Offer Type per Emotional Context"), 
                   lims_raw,
                   file.path("raw_cond",
                             paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_std_TC_Raw_Conditional")),
                   time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      df_slice <- df_tc_base %>%
        group_by(time, channel, offer_type) %>%
        summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = uV) %>%
        mutate(amplitude = unfair - fair)
      row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, "Unfair - Fair\n(Aggregated)", lims_diff_offer_main, spec$roi)
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Spatiotemporal Contrast: Unfair minus Fair"), 
                   lims_diff_offer_main,
                   file.path("diff_offer",
                             paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_std_TC_Diff_Offer_Main")),
                   time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in emotion_list) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>%
          filter(emotion %in% c(emo, "neu")) %>%
          group_by(time, channel, emotion) %>%
          summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = emotion, values_from = uV) %>%
          mutate(amplitude = !!sym(emo) - neu)
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste0(emotion_labels[emo], "\n- Neutral"), lims_diff_emo_main, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Spatiotemporal Contrast: Emotion minus Neutral"), 
                   lims_diff_emo_main,
                   file.path("diff_emotion",
                             paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_std_TC_Diff_Emotion_Main")),
                   time_win_str)

      row_plots <- list()
      for (emo in c("neu", emotion_list)) {
        df_slice <- df_tc_base %>%
          filter(emotion == emo) %>%
          group_by(time, channel, offer_type) %>%
          summarise(uV = mean(uV, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = offer_type, values_from = uV) %>%
          mutate(amplitude = unfair - fair)
        row_plots[[length(row_plots)+1]] <- build_tc_row(df_slice, paste0("Unfair - Fair\n(", emotion_labels[emo], ")"), lims_diff_cond_offer, spec$roi)
      }
      save_mega_tc(row_plots, paste(comp_name, "Spatiotemporal Contrast: Conditional Interactions"), 
                   lims_diff_cond_offer,
                   file.path("diff_cond",
                             paste0(comp_name, "_", experiment_id, "_std_TC_Diff_Conditional")),
                   time_win_str)
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("    Exportation complete. Assets localized at: %s\n", out_base))
  }
  
  graphics.off()
  closeAllConnections()
  gc(verbose = FALSE)
}

```
